caption:
Since April, Upwork's marketplace lives inside ChatGPT. A client can describe their project in plain language and get matched straight to a freelancer — no browsing profiles first.

That changes what makes a profile work. Matching runs on how specifically you've described your service, not how professional your resume-style bio sounds. 'Graphic designer' loses to 'logo redesign for small bakeries, 5-day turnaround.'

The prompt on slide 4 rewrites your profile the way a client would actually phrase their need. Save this before your next profile update.

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.

lines the way a client would type
their need into ChatGPT — specific
service, specific client type,
specific outcome.

body.t: Once matched, Upwork's own agent, Uma, scopes the work and drafts the contract.
Review anything it produces before you agree
— a matching algorithm isn't the same as a client who's read your terms.
